designSummary: Prediction model development from a 12-month prospective cohort.
sampleSize: About 620 procedures in 12 months with about 42 percent overnight stays give about 260 events. The surgeons' candidate list has 18 parameters once surgeon, list position categories and splines for age are counted, giving about 14 events per candidate parameter. That is enough to fit a penalised model but leaves no independent data for validation: a split would halve the events, and a temporal validation would need a second year of prospective collection, beyond the 2028 scheduling cycle. The retrieved review found that models validated on later data lost 0.05 to 0.11 in c statistic, so an unvalidated model would overstate performance.
primaryAnalysis: Penalised logistic regression with pre-specified predictors and bootstrap optimism correction.
secondaryAnalysis: Calibration plot; decision curve for booking thresholds.
missingData: Incomplete forms are expected when the recovery nurse is unavailable; multiple imputation if under 20 percent missing.
summary: About 260 events: enough to fit but not to validate within the time available.
